We had a presentation about Block in Blobs, EIP 8142 on ACD for Hegota, there was feedback that tying data with the payload would not work, and then moving it to a separate channel does work but it also immediately gives us faster block propagation. The point is that shipping **only** that part of the EIP is high return for a simple change. This would affect the ACD process cause rather than changing the content of the EIP and extracting "faster blocks" from the whole block in blobs seems to be simpler to just add a new EIP. I would want to know if you guys would be on board with this, if you think it's important and plausible then we may want to work on it and rush it to ACD, if you don't then we won't do anything. Please give it a read. 

https://www.potuz.net/posts/hegota-faster-blocks/
